issue.body:
## Summary:
Fixes issue [#45085](https://github.com/facebook/react-native/issues/45085) by aligning the error handling of setTimeout, clearTimeout, setInterval, and clearInterval functions in React Native with current web standards. This includes throwing a TypeError for invalid callbacks and ensuring clearTimeout and clearInterval fail silently for invalid IDs. Tests have been added to verify the changes.

Changelog:
[GENERAL] [FIXED] - Align timer functions' error handling with web standards.

## Test Plan:
Run yarn test to execute the test suite.
Verify all tests pass, including the newly added tests for setTimeout, clearTimeout, setInterval, and clearInterval by running yarn jest packages/react-native/Libraries/Core/Timers/__tests__/JSTimers-test.js from terminal.
